thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — P1: Dedicated reserved GPU pool 'resv-eu-west-3' reports sustained saturation (>99%) and queue growth for enterprise tenants. Affected tenant: ArcadiaHealth. Autoscaler errors observed. Paging on-call.
oncall-kyra: I'm on it. Seeing large enqueue rate into resv pool from ArcadiaHealth and one other enterprise tenant. Queue length ~12k, avg wait 18s -> rising. :eyes:
sre-lee: Confirming. Autoscaler logs show repeated 429 from quota-service during scale attempts (throttle). Scale attempts failing at ~3:17 UTC. Linking logs: `curl -s http://autoscaler.local/scale?pool=resv-eu-west-3` returns 429.
infra-jamal: 429 is from cloud quota limit on GPU attach calls, not our internal rate limit. We're hitting per-project attach API limit in eu-west-3. Opening ticket with cloud — ETA unknown.
oncall-kyra: Can we mitigate without new attachments? Options: eviction, tenant-level throttles, or route ArcadiaHealth to fallback model variant on hosted pool.
ml-eng-tessa: ArcadiaHealth workload is high concurrency chat sessions using long context windows; fallback to smaller quantized model will reduce GPU time but may impact latency/quality. We can spin them to a hosted xsmall for new sessions only.
customer-ops-miguel: Telegram ready to notify ArcadiaHealth about degraded performance if we take user-facing steps. Prefer to avoid hard evictions first.
sre-lee: Quick diagnostic patch: disable pre-warmed sessions for non-critical tenants to free ~8 GPUs immediately. oncall-kyra, want me to run the script?
oncall-kyra: Yes run it. Also prepare a throttle rule to cap ArcadiaHealth concurrency at 60% of their reservation to stabilize queues.
ops-bot: Executing `./scripts/drain-prewarm.sh --pool=resv-eu-west-3 --exclude=ArcadiaHealth` — started.
ops-bot: Prewarm drain completed. Freed ~7 GPU-equivalent capacity. Queue length dropped to ~7.2k in 90s.
infra-jamal: Cloud ticket update: we have a soft quota throttle from provider side; they recommend exponential backoff for attach calls. They'll raise limit if we file an expedited increase. Raising now.
ml-eng-tessa: Rolling canary for ArcadiaHealth new sessions -> route to hosted-quantized variant: `route set arcadia -> hosted-quant-q4 (new-sessions-only)`.
oncall-kyra: Implemented. New sessions now go to hosted fallback. Existing sessions remain on reserved pool.
sre-lee: Applied tenant throttle: concurrency cap at 60% of reservation for ArcadiaHealth. Implemented via rate limiter config update:
```
PATCH /config/quotas
{ "tenant": "ArcadiaHealth", "concurrency_pct": 60 }
```
ops-bot: Throttle config updated and pushed to edge proxies.
customer-ops-miguel: Messaging draft: "We're seeing degraded throughput in reserved GPUs in eu-west-3; we've applied throttles and routing to minimize impact. Working on capacity increase. We'll update in 30m." Approve?
oncall-kyra: Approve, send now. Keep updates every 15-30m until stable.
incident-bot: Metrics snapshot @1710504500: pool_util=99.2%, queue=7200, scale_attempts=12, failed_attaches=11.
sre-lee: After drain + throttle + routing: pool_util=86%, queue=2100, avg_wait=6s. Seems stable for now. Continue monitoring.
infra-jamal: Cloud raised limit to allow 4 attaches/minute. Autoscaler will backoff but should be able to add gradually. I'll watch attach error rate.
ml-eng-tessa: Note: fallback model increases per-request latency by ~120ms and reduces token cost by ~35%. Customer-facing impact minimal for new sessions.
oncall-kyra: Thanks. Miguel — customer message sent and acknowledging. Keep on stand-by for any SLA escalation.
customer-ops-miguel: ArcadiaHealth acknowledges receipt and asked for ETA. I told them we'll update in 30m and that new sessions are routed to a fallback model.
sre-lee: Action items: (1) postmortem owner: lee, (2) follow-up cloud quota increase ticket (infra-jamal), (3) evaluate autoscaler retry/backoff logic (sre-lee + infra-jamal), (4) create promptset eval to check quality regression on fallback model (ml-eng-tessa).
oncall-kyra: Marking incident as mitigated at 1710504921 — queue and utilization dropping, customer routed to fallback, cloud limit raised. Will remain on incident watch for 2 hours.
incident-bot: Incident status: MITIGATED -> monitoring. Open remediation tickets: #INC-171050 (autoscaler backoff), #CLOUD-171050 (quota increase). :white_check_mark:
sre-lee: Quick note for postmortem — consider adding emergency short-term reservation bump in control plane to allow transient attach bursts.
oncall-kyra: Agreed. Thanks everyone. If anything flares, reopen thread or page with PAGER-DIRECT.
customer-ops-miguel: I'll follow up with ArcadiaHealth 30m status update.
ops-bot: Log archive uploaded to /incidents/1710504321/artifacts (autoscaler logs, attach errors, metrics).
summary: Mitigated saturation of dedicated reserved GPU pool in eu-west-3 via prewarm drain, tenant throttling, and routing to hosted fallback. Postmortem owner assigned.
